papers.title: Isabelle/STARK: A Formalization of zk-STARK in Isabelle/HOL
papers.summary: This report describes an Isabelle/HOL formalization of a STARK-style transparent proof protocol. The development contains an executable model of the prover and verifier, a finite probabilistic state monad with a weakest-precondition calculus, a zero-failure honestcompleteness theorem, and a staged soundness theorem with an explicit probability bound. The report is written for readers with a formal-methods background. It gives enough cryptographic context to explain the protocol, but its main emphasis is the formal model, the decomposition of the proofs, and the Isabelle source locations of the principal definitions and theorems.

papers.title: New upper bound for multicolor Ramsey numbers
papers.summary:
Let $R_r(k)$ denote the diagonal $r$-color graph Ramsey number. We prove that there exist absolute constants $c,K>0$ such that \[
  R_r(k)\le
  \exp\!\left(-c\frac{k}{r^2\log^4(2r)}\right)r^{rk} \] for every $r\ge2$ and every $k\ge Kr^2\log^6(2r)$. The proof combines a positive-coefficient root filter of variable order with a retained-spine refinement of the multicolor book method.b

papers.title: Markov and lattice bases for Forman-Ricci curvature of graphs
papers.summary: Discrete Forman-Ricci curvature is a quantity associated to each edge of a graph that describes its local geometry. It has proven to be a useful tool in network analysis in a variety of applications. Recent work by Roost et al.\ (2024) proposed the use of Markov bases to sample from the space of graphs with prescribed vertex degrees and curvatures. In the present work, we further develop the algebraic and combinatorial theory of these Markov bases. We show that the degree of an indispensable Markov move grows at least quadratically in the maximum degree of the graph. In light of this result, a compact description of all Markov basis elements seems unattainable at present. Instead, we find a lattice basis for this problem using only degree three Markov moves, which allows us to employ recently-developed reinforcement learning methods for finding Markov moves that can be applied to a specific graph.

papers.title: New upper bound for the Ramsey number of odd cycles
papers.summary: The \emph{$k$-color Ramsey number} $R_k(C_{2\ell+1})$ is the least integer $n$ such that any $k$-edge-coloring of a complete graph $K_n$ has a monochromatic odd cycle $C_{2\ell+1}$. Axenovich, Cames van Batenburg, Janzer, Michel, and Rundström~(JCT-B, 2026) recently proved \[ R_k(C_{2\ell+1})\le (4\ell-2)^k k^{k/\ell}+1, \] and Miyazaki, Mulrenin, Pohoata, and Zheng further improved the factor $k^{k/\ell}$ to $(k!)^{1/\ell}$. As Jenssen and Skokan (AM, 2021) determined $R_k(C_{2\ell+1})$ for fixed $k$ and sufficiently large $\ell$, it becomes even more interesting to seek better bound for fixed $\ell$ and sufficiently large $k$. In this paper, we show \[ R_k(C_{2\ell+1}) \le \frac{2\ell}{2\ell-1}(2\ell-1)^k(k!)^{1/\ell} \exp\!\left(k^{1-1/\ell}+O_\ell\!\left(k^{1-2/\ell}+\log k\right)\right)+1 \] for every fixed $\ell\ge 2$ and sufficiently large $k$, which improves the bound of Miyazaki et al. by a factor $2^{k-o(k)}$, and the bound of Axenovich et al. by a factor $(2\e^{1/\ell})^{k-o(k)}$.

papers.title: Powerful multiplicative groups do not force right nilpotence in finite braces
papers.summary: For every odd prime $p$, we construct a finite left brace $A_p$ of order $p^{2p+1}$ whose additive group is elementary abelian and whose multiplicative group $G_p$ is a powerful $p$-group, but such that $A_p$ is not right nilpotent. More precisely, $G_p'=G_p^p\cong C_p^2$, $\operatorname{cl}(G_p)=2$, $\operatorname{exp}(G_p)=p^2$, and $\operatorname{Soc}(A_p)=0$. Thus powerfulness does not force right nilpotence even for multiplicative groups of class two with derived subgroup of order $p^2$. The obstruction is explicit: $A_p$ contains a three-dimensional trivial ideal $T$ satisfying $T*A_p=T$, whereas its left series is the ideal-power filtration of a nilpotent commutative algebra. Both $T$ and $A_p/T$ are right nilpotent, so right nilpotence of finite left braces is not closed under extensions. The construction is uniform and arises from a finite local commutative algebra, a square-zero derivation, and an invariant character, yielding a regular affine subgroup as the kernel of a character on a semidirect product. It disproves the Shalev--Smoktunowicz conjecture in every odd characteristic and yields finite irretractable involutive set-theoretic solutions of the Yang--Baxter equation whose permutation groups are powerful $p$-groups of class two.

papers.title: The maximum index and spectral radius of unbalanced signed multipartite graphs
papers.summary: Let $Γ=(G,σ)$ be a signed graph, where $G$ is the underlying graph with vertex set $V(G)$ and edge set $E(G)$ such that $σ: E(G)\to \{-1,1\}$ is the sign function. For $U\subset V(G)$, the operation that changes the sign of all edges between $U$ and $V(G)\setminus U$ is called switching. Two signed graphs with the same underlying graph are switching equivalent if one is obtainable from the other one by switching a subset. Two signed graphs are switching isomorphic if one is isomorphic to a switching equivalent signed graph of the other one. A signed cycle is called negative if it contains an odd number of negative edges. A signed graph is balanced if none of its cycles is negative; otherwise it is unbalanced. The adjacency matrix $A(Γ)$ of $Γ$ is obtained from the standard $(0,1)$-adjacency matrix of $G$ by reversing the sign of all $1$s which correspond to negative edges. The index of $Γ$ is the largest eigenvalue of $A(Γ)$ and the spectral radius of $Γ$ is the largest absolute value of the eigenvalue of $A(Γ)$. The least eigenvalue of $Γ$ is the least eigenvalue of $A(Γ)$. We study the extremal problems of the index and the spectral radius among unbalanced signed multipartite graphs. More precisely, we determine the unbalanced signed $t$-partite graphs with fixed $t\ge 2$ and partite sizes (order, respectively) that maximizes the index and the spectral radius respectively, up to switching isomorphism. To determine the unbalanced signed multipartite graphs with fixed partite sizes (order, respectively) with maximum spectral radius, we also determine those with minimum least eigenvalue.

papers.title: Bipartite Turán Numbers of Trees and Star Forests
papers.summary:
The bipartite Turán number of a graph $H$, denoted $\text{ex}(m, n; H)$, is the maximum
  number of edges in any $H$-free bipartite graph $G = (A, B; E)$ with parts of size $|A| = m$ and $|B| = n$. We study this problem for two families. For a tree $T = T(r, s)$ with parts $R$ and $S$ of sizes $|R| = r \le s = |S|$, we prove
  \[
  (r - 1) n \;\le\; \text{ex}(m, n; T(r, s)) \;\le\; (r - 1) n + O(m)
  \]
  for $n$ sufficiently large compared to $m$, $r$, and $s$, determining the leading-order term exactly (with the star case $r=1$ solved with an exact formula). For a star forest $F = \bigcup_{i=1}^k S_{d_i}$ with $d_1 \ge \cdots \ge d_k$, we determine the exact value $\text{ex}(m, n; F) = (k - 1) n + (d_k - 1)(m - k + 1)$ for $n$ sufficiently large, and characterize the unique extremal graph.

papers.title: $0/1$-Polytopes with Exponentially Small Edge Expansion
papers.summary: We present a construction of a family of $0/1$-polytopes whose edge expansion decreases exponentially with the dimension, which disproves the Mihail-Vazirani conjecture that the graph of every $0/1$-polytope has edge expansion at least one.

papers.title: Exponential mixing for Korteweg-de Vries equation with localized noise
papers.summary: We establish exponential mixing for the randomly forced and weakly damped KdV equation in $L^2(\mathbb{T})$. The noise is bounded, localized, and degenerate in high frequencies. Our proof relies on a general probabilistic framework in [11,33], nonlinear smoothing for KdV and its linearization via normal form transformation, and stabilization of the system by localized force. This paper continues a series of works connecting asymptotic compactness, control theory, and ergodicity and mixing for randomly forced dispersive PDEs.

papers.title: Factorial residues modulo a prime: beyond the square-root bound
papers.summary: For a prime \(p\), let \(A_p=\{k!\pmod p:1\leq k<p\}\). We prove \(|A_p|\gg p^{8/15}\), improving the general lower bound \((\sqrt{2}-o(1))p^{1/2}\). The proof begins with the identity \((n+2)!=(n+1)!+((n+1)!)^2/n!\) in \(\mathbb{F}_p\), which produces many incidences for a family of fractional-linear maps. After Cauchy--Schwarz, the transition maps between two members of this family become affine lines, with multiplicity at most two. The Cartesian-product point-line incidence theorem of Stevens and de Zeeuw then yields the exponent \(8/15\).

papers.title: EntailLLM: Verifying LLM-Generated Vulnerability Discovery Paths with Domain Knowledge via Logic Programming
papers.summary: Large language models are increasingly used to reason about software vulnerabilities, but their outputs can silently violate domain knowledge, limiting their reliability in safety-critical settings such as medical devices. Prior work either treats that output as a prediction to be scored or constrains it to walks within a single knowledge graph; neither checks whether reasoning over a binary is consistent with an independent body of domain knowledge. We present EntailLLM, which validates each LLM-proposed analyst path by entailment: the path is a traversal of the binary's function call graph, the domain knowledge is represented in a separate graph, and verification aligns the two under temporal annotated logic. Across three CWE classes, four LLMs, three prompting strategies, and seven binaries varying in size from 405 to 12,696 function call-graph nodes, domain knowledge raises pooled entailment from 78% to 98%, with entailment decreasing in only 3% of the experiments. EntailLLM is deployed end-to-end on real medical-device binaries, reaching 98% pooled entailment without per-device tuning. Our system inherits the formal guarantees of generalized annotated logic, providing logical verification of LLM output that is both explainable and grounded in well-defined semantics.

papers.title: The problem of recognition of finite simple groups by element orders is solved
papers.summary: For a finite group $G$, let $ω(G)$ be the set of element orders of $G$ and let $h(G)$ be the number of pairwise nonisomorphic finite groups $H$ with $ω(H)=ω(G)$. We say that the recognition problem is solved for $G$ if the number $h(G)$ is known, and if it is finite, then all finite groups $H$ with $ω(H)=ω(G)$ are listed. We complete the solution of the recognition problem for all finite simple groups.

papers.title: A Characterization of Trees with Trinomial Partial Petrial Polynomials
papers.summary: The partial Petrial polynomial of a bouquet can be computed from the coranks over GF(2) of matrices obtained by varying the diagonal entries of the adjacency matrix of its intersection graph. Motivated by this matrix formulation, we study the corresponding polynomial for simple graphs and determine when it has exactly two or three nonzero terms. A key tool is the interpolating property: the exponents of the nonzero terms are consecutive. Using this property together with local complementation minors of grafts, we extend the known characterization of the binomial case from connected circle graphs to all connected simple graphs, showing that such a graph has a binomial partial Petrial polynomial if and only if it is a path. Our main result characterizes the trinomial case for trees: a tree has a trinomial partial Petrial polynomial if and only if it is a T-shape tree or an H-shape tree. Here, a T-shape tree has maximum degree 3 and exactly one vertex of degree 3, whereas an H-shape tree has maximum degree 3 and exactly two vertices of degree 3, which are adjacent. We also derive explicit formulas for both families in terms of Jacobsthal numbers.

papers.title: A Lovász Theta Parameter and Theta Body for Signed Graphs
papers.summary: We introduce a Lovász-type semidefinite parameter for balanced colouring of signed graphs. Its homomorphism target is a unit sphere equipped with an orthogonal involution: the fixed and anti-fixed components play different roles, while applying the involution to one endpoint realizes switching. The resulting parameter admits a symmetric formulation with two positive semidefinite matrices and an equally symmetric dual. It is also one half of the strict vector chromatic number of the ordinary graph formed by the negative edges of the double switching graph. Our second main contribution is a hierarchy of convex corners. Starting from the balanced induced subgraph polytope, we define signed analogues of the stable-set, theta, and clique-inequalities relaxations in the original vertex space. The signed theta body has an intrinsic two-matrix description, its all-ones gauge is the new scalar parameter, and the ordinary stable-set hierarchy is recovered exactly from signed digon graphs. For all-negative signatures, the construction becomes a relaxation of the maximum induced bipartite subgraph problem and is related to the generalized theta number. Finally, we propose a notion of balanced perfectness and show that it is strictly weaker than perfectness of the associated double-cover graph.

papers.title: Monodromy action on character varieties for Lefschetz pencils
papers.summary: Given a Riemann surface Σ, let Γ {\subseteq} Mod(Σ) denote the monodromy subgroup of a family of complex curves homeomorphic to Σ, arising from a sufficently ample Lefschetz pencil. We establish that the group Γ acts with Zariski dense orbits or ergodically on certain character varieties for {π_1}(Σ). This answers a version of a Conjecture of Katzarkov, Pantev, and Simpson appearing in [KPS03].

papers.title: A lower bound for the second largest up-Laplacian eigenvalue of a simplicial complex
papers.summary:
Let $K$ be a finite $k$-dimensional simplicial complex with at least two $k$-faces, and let $\Lup_{k-1}(K)=\partial_k\partial_k^{\T}$ be its $(k-1)$-dimensional up-Laplacian. Writing $d_2(K)$ for the second largest upper degree of a $(k-1)$-face, we prove the sharp bound \[
  λ_2\bigl(\Lup_{k-1}(K)\bigr)\ \ge\ d_2(K)+k-1 . \] For $k=1$, this recovers the graph inequality $λ_2(L(G))\ge d_2(G)$ of Li and Pan. We also show that the full graph inequality of Brouwer and Haemers does not extend directly to simplicial complexes: the natural candidate $λ_m(\Lup_{k-1}(K))\ge d_m(K)-m+k+1$ already fails for $m=3$.

papers.title: The Godsil--McKay Asymptotic for Latin Rectangles in the Sublinear Range of Erdős Problem 725
papers.summary: Erdős Problem 725 asks for an asymptotic formula for the number $L_{k,n}$ of ordered, labelled $k\times n$ Latin rectangles. Godsil and McKay proved that $L_{k,n}\sim (n!)^k((n)_k/n^k)^n(1-k/n)^{-n/2}e^{-k/2}$ for $k=o(n^{6/7})$. We provide a partial solution to Erdős Problem 725 by proving this asymptotic for every $k=o(n)$. More precisely, set $\widetilde A_{k,n}=(n!)^k((n)_k/n^k)^n\exp\{[n(H_n-H_{n-k})-k]/2\}$. For every $K(n)=o(n)$, uniformly for $0\leq k\leq K(n)$, we prove $\log(L_{k,n}/\widetilde A_{k,n})=O(k^2/n^2)$, with an absolute implied constant. The results of this paper have been formally verified in Lean.

papers.title: Non-KKT Accumulation in Entropic Mirror Descent
papers.summary: For mirror descent generated by a Legendre kernel, perhaps one of the most basic question in optimization is this: must every accumulation point of a bounded mirror descent sequence be Karush--Kuhn--Tucker (KKT) stationary under proper stepsizes? We show that the answer is no. A longstanding obstacle to resolving this question is the boundary blow-up of the Legendre gradient: it keeps every mirror step in the interior, while at a boundary limit, the inverse entropy metric vanishes on active coordinates and can erase the dual-feasibility in the KKT system. We construct $C^\infty$ objectives and bounded sequences generated by the Shannon-entropic mirror descent on the nonnegative orthant $\R_+^n$, for every $n\geq 3$, and on the probability simplex $Δ_n$, for every $n\geq 4$, such that, in each case, the set of accumulation points is a smooth boundary circle containing a nonempty relatively open arc of non-KKT points. The steps satisfy $α_k\asymp k^{-β}$ with $β\in(1/2,1)$, the objective values are nonincreasing, and the objectives are entropy-relatively smooth. Hence the pathology stems from the degeneracy of the Bregman geometry at the boundary, rather than from failure of descent, or improper stepsizes. To the best of our knowledge, these provide the first counterexamples to KKT accumulation for bounded mirror descent sequences with nonincreasing objective values.

papers.title: Conjugation invariants determine the metacommutation permutation only up to relabelling
papers.summary: Let $\mathcal{H}$ be the Hurwitz quaternions, $p$ an odd prime, and $Q \in \mathcal{H}$ a prime of norm $q \neq p$. Metacommutation $PQ = Q'P'$ induces a permutation $π_Q$ of the $p+1$ left-associate classes of primes of norm $p$. Cohn and Kumar compute its sign and fixed-point count, and Leite and Machiavelo its full cycle structure, by formulas depending only on conjugation-invariant data of $Q$ (namely $q$ and $\mathrm{tr}\,Q$). We prove this is exactly the boundary of what such invariants can carry: no quantity $I(Q)$ invariant under unit conjugation determines $π_Q$ as a labelled permutation of the intrinsic class set, or even the image of a single specified class. The proof combines an equivariance identity $π_{uQu^{-1}} = ρ_u π_Q ρ_u^{-1}$ with a minimal, fully explicit witness at $(p,q) = (3,5)$: the four primes $2+i$, $2+j$, $2+k$, $2-i$ form a single unit-conjugacy orbit, hence agree under every conjugation-invariant function, yet induce four pairwise distinct $4$-cycles of the same four classes. We further observe that isomorphisms $\mathcal{H}/p\mathcal{H} \to M_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$ form a torsor under $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)$, so no projective labelling of the classes is canonical, and that by orbit-stabilizer the datum of one destination $π_Q(C)$ is exactly a coset $g_Q G_C$ in $\mathrm{PGL}_2(\mathbb{F}_p)/G_C$. All sixteen refactorizations in the witness are listed in the appendix and have been verified by machine along two independent routes.

papers.title: An Improved Upper Bound on the Zarankiewicz Number z(43;2)
papers.summary: The Zarankiewicz number z(43;2) is the largest number of edges in a four-cycle-free bipartite graph with two parts of size 43. Reiman's bound gives z(43;2) <= 301, with equality only for the incidence graph of a projective plane of order six; no such plane exists, so z(43;2) <= 300. We prove z(43;2) <= 299. The argument is elementary and uses no computer search: a counting identity for the leave of the configuration shows that a hypothetical 300-edge graph admits one of exactly twenty-seven degree profiles per side, of which only four combinations are locally compatible. Three force two vertices to share six neighbours; the fourth forces a transversal design TD(6,6), hence four mutually orthogonal Latin squares of order six, contradicting Tarry's theorem. We also give an explicit 284-edge construction inside PG(2,7), so that 284 <= z(43;2) <= 299.

papers.title: Finite abelian subgroups of algebraic groups
papers.summary:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field, and let $G$ be an algebraic $k$-group. We study finite abelian $k$-subgroups $A \subset G$ whose order is not divisible by the characteristic of $k$. This is a classical topic in the theory of algebraic groups going back to the work of Borel in the early 1960s. We sharpen previously known results on the structure of $A$. In particular, we show that there exists a maximal torus $T$ of $G$ such that the index $[A: (A \cap T)]$ divides the Grothendieck torsion index $t(G)$. We also show that there exists a maximal torus $T$ such that the quotient group $A/(A \cap T)$ is ``small'' in a suitable sense.
  As applications of these results, we (i) give a positive answer to a question of Totaro for $G$-torsors over fields $k_r = k((t_1))((t_2)) \ldots ((t_r))$ of iterated Laurent series, (ii) prove a variant of the ``hypothèse optimiste'' of Tits about splitting fields of $E_8$-torsors, and (iii) show that certain torsors over $k_r$ cannot be split by the function field of a genus $1$ curve.

papers.title: The Riemann Problem for a 3x3 Generalized Chaplygin Gas System with Variable Pressure
papers.summary:
We consider the Riemann problem for a 3x3 system of conservation laws with generalized Chaplygin pressure $p(ρ,v)=-\frac{A(v)}{ρ^α}$, $0<α\leq 1$, where the pressure depends on an additional transported variable. We analyze the system's wave structure and classify the Riemann solutions. Whenever classical solutions consisting of shocks, rarefaction waves, and contact discontinuities fail to exist, singular solutions arise. We verify that these satisfy the conservation laws in the distributional sense within the classical Dirac delta framework, and compare them with Nedeljkov's shadow-wave construction, giving two complementary descriptions of the same singular solution. We further study admissibility via the Dafermos maximum entropy dissipation principle, with several examples showing how it selects the physically relevant solution. Lax-Friedrichs simulations illustrate the Riemann wave patterns and provide a comparison with the analytical results.
  To construct viscous profiles for the isolated overcompressive $δ$-shock, we assume $α\in\mathbb{Q}\cap(0,1]$ and apply the Dafermos regularization together with a spherical blow-up. Working in three directional charts, we construct the reduced singular concatenation consisting of the left outer orbit, the middle orbit on the blown-up boundary, and the right outer orbit. We then prove that, for sufficiently small positive viscosity, this singular concatenation perturbs to a heteroclinic orbit. Consequently, the isolated overcompressive $δ$-shock is realized as the zero-viscosity limit of a family of self-similar Dafermos viscous profiles.

papers.title: Optimal and quasi-optimal locating-dominating densities in the infinite hexagonal grid with a finite number of rows
papers.summary: A set of vertices $S$ of a graph $G$ is locating-dominating if $S$ is dominating and, for each pair of distinct vertices not in $S$, their neighborhoods in $S$ are distinct. We present results on the minimum density of such sets in the infinite hexagonal grid with a finite number of rows $k$, also known as the hexagonal strip of width $k$, which we denote by $H_k$. For each $k\geq 2$, we present either an optimal solution or a quasi-optimal solution for $H_k$ that is within $1.3\%$ of the optimum. We describe an exact exponential-time algorithm for fixed k, which we implemented to find optimal solutions for $k \leq 5$. As the infinite grid $H_{k}$ always admits a periodic optimal solution, to deal with larger values of $k$, we present an integer linear program that finds an optimal periodic solution for $H_{k}$ for each fixed period. This program yields high-quality feasible solutions for $H_7$ and $H_8$, which we then combine with an optimal solution for $H_3$ to obtain quasi-optimal solutions for all $k\geq 6$. All these solutions admit a very short description.

papers.title: Analyticity of Lyapunov Exponents for Mixed Markov Quasi-Periodic Cocycles
papers.summary: We study the dependence of the top Lyapunov exponent of a mixed Markov quasi-periodic cocycle on the transition probabilities. The transition matrix is assumed primitive, the Markov extension on the torus is assumed non-resonant along directed cycles, and the top Lyapunov exponent is assumed simple. We first prove the result in the irreducible case by a forward Markov transfer operator and contraction estimates uniform over the initial Markov state. The reducible case is then obtained, as in the Bernoulli argument of Bezerra-Sánchez-Tall, by decomposing along measurable invariant sections into restricted and quotient bundle cocycles and inducting on the fiber dimension. A measurable invariant section need not admit a continuous trivialization, even when the original matrices cocycle are continuous. We therefore formulate the irreducible analytic case for essentially bounded measurable bundle cocycles with essentially bounded inverses.

papers.title: Projective-Plane Sharp States and Repulsion in Linear Crown-Free Hypergraphs
papers.summary: Let $3 \le k \le r$, and let $C^r_{1,k}$ be the $r$-uniform $k$-crown. Set $q=r-1$, $t=k-1$, $D=tq+1$, and $D^-=(t-1)q+1$. For every edge $e$ of a linear $C^r_{1,k}$-free $r$-graph, $Φ_H(e):=\sum_{v\in e}1/d_H(v)\ge r/D$. We classify equality: $e$ is sharp if and only if $e$ and all edges meeting it form $t$ projective planes of order $q$ glued along the common line $e$. This equality state is repulsive. If $f\ne e$ meets a sharp edge $e$, then at least $q-t+2$ vertices of $f\setminus e$ have degree at most $D^-$. It follows that sharp edges are pairwise disjoint, every edge meets at most $t-1$ sharp edges, and $|V^-(H)|\ge r(D-1)(q-t+2)|S(H)|/((t-1)D^-)$. Combining sharp-state repulsion with the integral defect of every nonsharp edge gives an unconditional strict improvement over the coefficient $D/r$. Define $B_{r,k}=r(D-1)/(t-1)$, $β_{r,k}=B_{r,k}/(B_{r,k}+1)$, and $η_{r,k}=(q-t+2)/D^- - q/D$. If $η_{r,k}>0$, equivalently if $t=2$, or if $t\ge 3$ and $q\ge t(t-2)+1$, then $|E(H)|\le D(D-1)|V(H)|/(r(D-1)+1)$. For the remaining parameters, $|E(H)|\le D(D-1)|V(H)|/(r(D-1)+β_{r,k})$. For fixed $k$, the first bound holds for all sufficiently large $r$ and improves $D/r$ by $r^{-2}+O_k(r^{-3})$. For $k=3$, every component containing a sharp edge is exactly a pair of projective planes glued along that edge. For $k\ge 4$, light attachments may occur throughout a sharp core, but only $O_k(r)$ affine points can have degree greater than $D^-$. We also prove a quantitative near-sharp localization theorem: after deleting a controlled exceptional family, the neighborhood of a near-sharp edge splits into $t$ large packets with approximate affine-plane row-column incidence.

papers.title: Idempotents, automorphism groups, and commutator widths of quandle algebras
papers.summary: The paper develops the theory of quandle algebras. We show that over integral domains of characteristic other than 2, quandle algebras of ordered commutative quandles have no nontrivial idempotents. We also compute the automorphism groups of quandle algebras of trivial quandles and dihedral quandles of odd orders over arbitrary commutative rings, with partial results for dihedral quandles of even orders. Finally, a computer search provides the first examples of quandle algebras of commutator width 2.

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02936v1.title: 多角形における屈折外部ビリヤード
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02936v1.summary: 本論文では、近年の屈折ビリヤードの研究を拡張し、凸多角形における屈折外部ビリヤード（refractive outer billiards）の系を導入し、その性質を調査している。GutkinとSimanyi（1992年）が準有理多角形における軌道の有界性や有理多角形における周期性を示し、TabachnikovとCulter（2007年）が全ての凸多角形における外部ビリヤード系で周期軌道が存在することを証明したが、本研究ではこれらの結果を屈折を伴う設定へと一般化した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02936v1.appendix: 本論文は力学系（dynamics）を扱っており、興味ある分野の中では arithmetic dynamics や complex dynamics との関連性が示唆されます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02933v1.title: フローから写像へ：アトラクタ強度と有界ノイズ脱出に関するサンプリング則
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02933v1.summary: 本論文は、連続系アトラクタの「アトラクタ強度（intensity of attraction）」と、その時間 h 写像（時間離散化）における強度の関係を明らかにしています。L-リプシッツベクトル場において、離散化された強度 μ_h(A) を時間刻み h で割った値が、h → 0 のとき連続系の強度 μ(A) に収束することを示し、その収束レートが一般に 1 次であることを証明しました。この理論を数値計算手法や非自律系のアトラクタ、有界ノイズ下の脱出問題に拡張し、離散的な観測やシミュレーションから得られる強度が、連続系の特性を正しく反映することを保証しています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02933v1.appendix: 本論文は、complex dynamics や validated numerics に関連する力学系の安定性と数値的挙動を扱っており、サンプリングに基づく動的システムの解析手法を提供しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02930v1.title: アトミックな概念学習におけるハイパーキューブ、ハイパープレーン、および制約誘導型計算量崩壊
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02930v1.summary: 本論文は、高アリティのアトミックな概念学習を、グラウンド・インスタンスの集合が構成するr次元ハイパーキューブの幾何学的性質から再考した研究である。r次元空間内の論理的複雑性は一様ではなく、ハイパープレーンの構造によって組織化されていることを示している。具体的には、主対角線（full diagonal）を除くすべてのハイパープレーンにおいて、項の深さに依存しない有限個の基本同値類（elementary-equivalence classes）への計算量崩壊が起こる一方、主対角線のみは例外的にクラス数が無制限に増大する。この非対称性を簡約理論の観点から解釈し、3次元モデル等の具体例を通じて、複雑性がインスタンス空間全体に分散せず局在化していることを明らかにしている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02930v1.appendix: 提示された「興味ある分野」に直接該当するキーワードは見当たりませんが、項の構造や組合せ論的な複雑性を扱う点において、combinatorics on wordsやformal languagesの基盤となる論理構造に関連する可能性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02894v1.title: 10個のファセットを持つコンパクトな双曲的Coxeter 6次元多胞体
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02894v1.summary: 本論文では、等長を除いて唯一存在する、10個のファセットを持つコンパクトな双曲的Coxeter 6次元多胞体 P₆,₁₀ を同定した。これにより、d+4個のファセットを持つコンパクトな双曲的Coxeter d次元多胞体の全次元における分類が完了した。手法として、アフィンGale双対性を用いた10点平面順序型のデータベースから387個の組合せ論的候補を抽出し、Lannérの分類に基づく組合せ論的制約を用いて11型まで絞り込んだ。最終的に、二面角に先験的な制限を設けないCoxeterラベル付けの全探索を行い、マシンの証明書による検証を経て唯一の生存するGram行列を特定した。探索プロセスでは浮動小数点誤差に依存せず、代数的実数演算や区間演算を用いた厳密な判定が行われている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02894v1.appendix: 本論文は、計算機を用いた厳密な数学的証明（validated numerics）の手法を含んでおり、特に代数的な判定や区間演算による網羅的な探索プロセスの構築という点で、興味ある分野の「validated numerics」に深く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02873v1.title: 回帰集合内の直積集合と対称エルゴード平均の正値性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02873v1.summary: 本研究では、可算群 G の測度保存作用から生じる、{g ∈ G : μ(A ∩ T_gA) > 0} という形式の「回帰集合」を調査した。まず、G × G における回帰集合が、非アメナブル群でも定義可能な「大きさ」の概念に基づいた大きな集合 B による B × B という直積部分集合を含むことを示した。これにより G がアメナブルであれば、G × G の十分大きな部分集合 A に対して B × B ⊆ AA⁻¹ となる大きな B が存在することが導かれる。また、単一の群 G における回帰集合が直積集合 BB を含む条件についても検討し、これが対称相関関数 g ↦ μ(T_g⁻¹A ∩ T_gA) と密接に関連することを示した。有限生成冪零群や特定の可解非冪零群を含む広範なアメナブル群に対し、十分大きな A ⊆ G が BB ⊆ AA⁻¹ を満たす大きな B を含むことを証明した。さらに、これらの結果の多項式版への拡張も行っている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02873v1.appendix: 本論文は、構造的な性質を持つ大きな可算無限群（structure of large countable infinite group）の性質、特にアメナブル群や冪零群における組合せ論的・動力学的な側面を扱っており、指定された興味ある分野と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02857v1.title: 測地線ストリングの数え上げ不変量と多重度の算術
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02857v1.summary: 本研究は、測地流のFullerインデックスに基づき、完備なRiemann-Finsler多様体における測地線ストリング（閉測地線の再パラメータ化同値類）の有理数値カウントを分析している。主要な成果として、これらのカウントに対する積形式の公式を導出した。これをKAM理論と組み合わせることで、平坦計量に近いT²上のジェネリックなFinsler計量において、ある自由ホモトピー類βの測地線ストリングの多重度が素数pで割り切れるならば、別のストリングが存在することを示した。また、マッピング・トーラスや平坦束における閉測地線の数え上げに対する算術的制約や、負の断面曲率を持つ計量の存在に関する制約も得ている。これらの不変量は、無限次元商スタック [LX/S¹] 上のオービフォールド・モース・ホモロジーの影として解釈される。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02857v1.appendix: 本論文は力学系の数え上げを扱っており、興味ある分野の中では arithmetic dynamics に関連する側面を持っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02855v1.title: H(6)におけるランク2のアフィン不変部分多様体
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02855v1.summary: 本論文では、極小層 H(6) におけるランク 2 かつ rel 0 の算術的アフィン不変部分多様体の分類を行っています。証明手法は Apisa による種数3でのアプローチを拡張したものであり、低種数の境界層におけるランク 1 かつ rel 1 のシリンダー剛性（cylinder rigid）を持つアフィン不変部分多様体の分類へと帰着させて解析を行っています。代数的原始的なランク 2 かつ rel 0 の軌道閉包の既存の分類と合わせることで、H(6) におけるランク 2 のアフィン不変部分多様体の完全な記述を与えています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02855v1.appendix: この論文は、アーベル微分の層やモジュライ空間上の力学系を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち complex dynamics や arithmetic dynamics に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02596v1.title: ヤシの木の下での生産性維持：トロピカル半環における次数付き共効力型付けについて
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02596v1.summary: 本論文では、自然数上のトロピカル半環を次数付き共効力型付けの次数空間として用いることで、プログラムの生産性を保証しつつ、時間の経過を忠実にモデル化できることを示しています。関数引数に付与された次数 a は、その引数が即座に利用可能ではなく、a ステップ後に利用可能になることを示唆します。本研究では2つの形式体系を調査し、1つ目では再帰型への自然な制約によって生産性が保証され、Nakanoのlater modalityを埋め込めることを示しました。2つ目ではトロピカル次数付けを用いた新しい形式の交差型付けを提案し、型付け可能な項が遺伝的頭部正規形を持つ項と正確に一致することを証明しました。また、型付け可能性の判定が算術的階層において Π₂⁰ 完全であることも示されています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02596v1.appendix: 本論文は、計算機科学における型理論や形式言語の理論的側面に焦点を当てており、提示された[興味ある分野]（記号力学、語上の組合せ論、オートマトン理論、形式言語など）のうち、特に型システムを通じたプログラムの挙動解析という点で形式言語理論に関連性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02522v1.title: 奇数内周に関する Erdős-Hajnal 予想
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02522v1.summary: 1969年に Erdős と Hajnal が提唱した、彩色数が十分に大きいグラフは任意の内周 g と彩色数 k を持つ部分グラフを含むという予想について研究している。これまで g=4 の場合のみが Rödl (1977) によって証明されていたが、その際の上界は巨大なタワー関数であった。本論文では、マルチカラー・ラムゼー数に関する最新の知見を利用することで、g=4 の場合の上界を指数関数レベルまで改善した。さらに、奇数の内周 (odd-girth) に限定した Mohar と Wu (2018) の予想を肯定的に解決し、任意の奇数 g≧5 に対して彩色数に関する境界が存在することを証明した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02522v1.appendix: この論文は組合せ論（Combinatorics）の重要な未解決問題に関わっており、提示された興味ある分野の中では combinatorics on words と基盤となる組合せ論的構造において関連性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02494v1.title: 標数0の体上における楕円曲線の同種写像グラフ
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02494v1.summary: 標数0の体 K 上で定義され、End_K E ≅ ℤ を満たす楕円曲線 E の同種写像グラフ 𝒢(E/K) の分類を行った。研究ではまず、𝒢(E/K) が各素数 p に対する p-べき同種写像グラフの弱直積に分解されることを示し、問題を p-べき同種写像グラフの分類に帰着させた。p 進ガロア表現を GL₂(ℤₚ) の部分群として詳細に解析することで、これらのグラフが特定の重み付きグラフの族（H_{pᵏ}ʳ および H_{p^{∞,+}}ʳ）のいずれかと同型であることを証明した。さらに、アデール・ガロア表現を用いた同種写像グラフの決定アルゴリズムの提示や、有理数体上の同種写像グラフの分類の再構築、GRH（一般化リーマン予想）の下での特定代数体上での分類も行っている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02494v1.appendix: 本論文は数論幾何学を主眼としていますが、複素力学系（complex dynamics）や数論力学系（arithmetic dynamics）において重要な対象である楕円曲線の変換やそのグラフ構造を扱っており、これらの分野と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02454v1.title: 有限トレースの技法による無限トレース目的：LTLからLTLf+への変換
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02454v1.summary: 線形時相論理(LTL)の仕様を解く際、従来は無限語上の非決定性オートマトンへの変換と決定化が必要であり、これが理論・実践の両面で困難を伴っていた。本論文では、LTLを有限トレース論理LTLfの拡張であるLTLf+へと変換する初の手法を提案する。まずLTL式をManna-Pnueli階層のsyntactic reactivityフラグメントに正規化し、各コンポーネントを線形変換する。これにより、LTLf+向けに開発された効率的な有限語オートマトンの決定化や最小化手法をLTLの諸問題に適用可能とし、かつオートマトン構築までの計算量は従来の二重指数関数時間の範囲内に収まることを示した。
keywords: LTLf+ Linearly Temporal Logic on Finite Traces Plus
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02454v1.appendix: 本論文は、オートマトン理論 (automata theory) および形式言語 (formal languages) の分野と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02435v1.title: 線形制約付きエルゴード最適化
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02435v1.summary: コンパクト距離空間 X 上の連続写像 T と連続関数 φ に対して、T-不変なボレル確率測度 μ のうち、与えられた制約セット C 内のすべての関数 g に対してその積分値が 0 となるような測度の集合 M_C(X,T) 上で φ の積分を最大化する問題を考察している。本研究では、この制約付き最適化問題における M_C(X,T) の非空性や最適解の存在といった基本性質を解明するとともに、最適測度の一意性が生成的・普及的（generic and prevalent）であることを示した。さらに、実現定理の提示や双対問題のキャラクタライゼーションも行い、本枠組みが力学系や最適輸送における既存の諸問題を一般化するものであることを明らかにした。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02435v1.appendix: 制約付きの力学系における最適化という側面で、complex dynamics 等の力学系全般の理論と関連する可能性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02704v1.title: 予測集合論（Predictive Set Theory）：操作定義された核となるメカニズムを備えた認知アーキテクチャのための生成論的フレームワーク
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02704v1.summary: 既存の予測処理理論やベイズ認知科学における、予測の構造や離散的な参照対象の生成メカニズムの欠如を指摘し、第一原理から認知アーキテクチャを再構築する「予測集合論（PST）」を提案する。本フレームワークは、センサ（恒等関数）、集合論的な状態更新、および3つの参照連鎖（reference, counter-reference, semi-reference）を最小演算として定義し、状態系列、比較、有限ホライゾン確率計画などの認知機能を導出する。不完全な情報と不可逆的なリスクの下で一貫性を維持するシステムの設計仕様として、ラッセルのパラドックスやゲーデルの不完全性定理などの諸問題に対し新たな解釈を与えるものである。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02704v1.appendix: 本論文が提示する認知プロセスの形式的記述や状態系列の生成モデルは、symbolic dynamicsやautomata theoryの枠組みと概念的な関連を持つ可能性があります。また、論理的一貫性や極限状況下でのシステム設計という観点は、形式言語や計算機科学の基礎理論とも親和性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02327v1.title: W*-超剛性を持たないICC特性(T)群
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02327v1.summary: 本論文では、ICCかつカジュダンの特性(T)を持つ、2つの具体的な可算離散群 Γ₁ と Γ₂ を構築した。これらの群は互いに同型ではないが、それぞれの群フォン・ノイマン環は同型（L(Γ₁) ≅ L(Γ₂)）となる。これは、ICC特性(T)群に関するコンヌの剛性予想に対する反例を提示するものである。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02327v1.appendix: 本論文は「structure of large countable infinite group」の分野に密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02295v1.title: MechGeo: Lean 4におけるユークリッド幾何学の自動形式化および証明
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02295v1.summary: 本論文では、ユークリッド幾何学の忠実な自動形式化と検証済み証明構築を統合的に扱う、Mathlibネイティブなエージェントフレームワーク「MechGeo」を提案している。このフレームワークは、自然言語の問題を中間表現GeoIRを介してLean 4へ変換し、構造的診断と意味論的評価を用いて形式化を修正するGeoFormalizerと、幾何学的証明計画の立案および代数的計算をLeanのカーネルで検証するGeoProverで構成される。IMOの過去問を含む実験において、従来のLLM直訳よりも大幅な性能向上を確認し、LEAPベンチマーク等の難問に対して世界初となるカーネル検証済みの証明や、誤った命題に対する反例の自動生成に成功した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02295v1.appendix: 本論文は、記号計算や形式言語を用いた幾何学的推論の自動化を扱っており、直接的な関連はありませんが、計算機による数学的証明の厳密な検証という観点では、興味ある分野のvalidated numericsやautomata theoryの応用先としての形式手法と共通の背景を持ちます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02282v1.title: Rigid Functions, IP-Systems, and Topological Mild Mixing
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02282v1.summary: 本論文では、連続な可観測量（observables）を通じた一様剛性（uniform rigidity）と位数的弱混合性（topological mild mixing）の研究を行っています。特定の時間列に沿ったリジッドな可観測量は、閉じられた単位元を持つ T^{±1} 不変代数を形成し、その時間列に沿った最大の一様リジッド因子を決定します。また、古典的な SIP* および IP* 回帰時間基準の関数形式を提示し、位相力学系が弱混合的であることの必要十分条件が、定数でない局所 SIP-rigid な可観測量が存在しないことであることを示しました。さらに、極小力学系の範疇において、同様の性質が定数でない局所 IP-rigid な可観測量の不在と同値であることを明らかにしています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02282v1.appendix: この論文は力学系の構造を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち symbolic dynamics に関連する理論的な基礎を提供しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02281v1.title: メタ巡回群の巾グラフのスペクトル特性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02281v1.summary: 本論文では、群 Ω の要素を頂点とし、一方が他方のべき乗である場合に辺を張る「巾グラフ」 P(Ω) について、メタ巡回群のクラスにおける構造を完全に特徴付けた。この構造記述に基づき、隣接行列、ラプラス行列、および符号なしラプラス行列の特性多項式に対する明示的な式を導出している。さらに、隣接行列と符号なしラプラス行列のスペクトル半径に関する上下限を求めている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02281v1.appendix: 本論文は、群の組合せ論的構造（power graph）を扱っており、興味ある分野のうち「combinatorics on words」や「strucure of large countable infinite group」に関連する群論的な側面を持っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02210v1.title: 対称群におけるワードマップと曲面関係式
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02210v1.summary: 本論文では、曲面群の制約条件下でワードマップを通じて得られるランダム置換の不動点の個数の期待値を研究している。対称群 Sₙ の安定既約指標 χ、および R_g = [a₁, b₁]…[a_g, b_g] と w ∈ F₂_g に対し、E[χ(R_g(h)) #fix(w(h))] を計算した。w が曲面群 Γ_g = ⟨a₁, b₁, ..., a_g, b_g : R_g⟩ における共役類 γ の最短代表元であるとき、この期待値が O(1/dim χ) となることを示した。応用として、γ ∈ Γ_g を固定し、一様ランダムに選ばれた準同型 φₙ ∈ hom(Γ_g, S_n) における φₙ(γ) の不動点数の期待値に関する Magee–Puder の有界性定理を再導出した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02210v1.appendix: 本論文は興味ある分野のうち「group theory」に関連する内容を含んでいますが、直接的には「structure of large countable infinite group」や「combinatorics on words」の周辺領域に関わっています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02193v1.title: 融合積のpro-p完了における残留プロファイルと有界生成性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02193v1.summary: 本論文は、頂点群が有界生成である場合に、融合積のpro-p完了が有界生成性を持つための完全な分類を行っている。まず、任意の抽象的な融合積のpro-p完了が常に適切なpro-p融合積を形成することを証明した。この枠組みにおいて、有界生成性が保たれるのは極めて稀であり、頂点群の一方がエッジ群に完全に一致するか、あるいはp=2かつ両方の頂点群がエッジ群に対して指数2である場合に限られることを示した。また、頂点群やエッジ群が崩壊せずに完了群へ写るための判定基準を新たに開発した。さらに、特定の素数pでpro-p完了が有界生成であっても、全射プロ有限完了が有界生成になるとは限らないという反例も提示している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02193v1.appendix: 本論文は、無限群の構造、特にプロ有限群の有界生成性や融合積の性質を扱っており、[興味ある分野]のうち「strucure of large countable infinite group」に強く関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02186v1.title: マルチシンギュラリティ双曲フローにおけるKomuro拡張性と周期軌道の増加について
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02186v1.summary: 本論文では、C¹フローのすべてのマルチシンギュラリティ双曲集合がKomuro拡張性（Komuro expansive）を持つことを証明しています。これは、正規軌道が特異点に蓄積するフローに対する最も強力な拡張性の形式であり、向きを保存する任意の時間再パラメータ化を許容するものです。この性質を用いて、周期軌道の数に対してeʰᵗ/tの形式での両側漸近評価を確立し、正規化された軌道測度が唯一の最大エントロピー測度に収束することを示しています。さらに、C¹開かつ稠密なスターベクトル場の部分集合に対しても同様の結果を導いています。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02186v1.appendix: symbolic dynamicsに関連する最大エントロピー測度や周期軌道の計数に関する研究内容を含んでいます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02184v1.title: パラメータ付きマルコフモデルにおけるPAC近似とDIRECT最適化
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02184v1.summary: 本論文は、遷移確率がパラメータ式で表されるパラメータ付きマルコフ決定過程（pMDP）におけるパラメータ合成および最適化問題を扱っています。特定の性質を満たす確率をパラメータの関数として計算するコストを削減するため、著者らは「シナリオアプローチ」を採用し、確率的に略正確な（PAC）近似関数を効率的に合成する手法を提案しています。この手法では、パラメータ設定のサンプリングと線形計画法の解法を組み合わせることで、指定された信頼度と誤差範囲内で妥当な多項式近似を得ることができます。さらに、微分を使用しない大域最適化アルゴリズムであるDIRECTを統合し、リプシッツ連続性などの仮定の下で、真の最適値と最適化結果の差に関する理論的保証を与えています。約3000のベンチマークを用いた評価では、提案手法が既存のシナリオ最適化手法と比較して、多くの場合で実行速度が速く、かつPAC誤差の範囲内で良好な解を得られることが示されました。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02184v1.appendix: 本論文は、マルコフモデルの解析や最適化を扱っており、オートマトン理論（automata theory）や形式言語（formal languages）の基礎となる確率モデルの検証に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02182v1.title: Laskarの周波数マップ解析の再考
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02182v1.summary: 本論文では、Laskarが提唱した周波数マップ解析において、従来の多項式収束境界を厳密に改善する指数収束性を確立している。適切な重み関数を選択することにより、Diophantine条件またはBrjuno非共鳴条件を満たす周波数ベクトルに対する解析的準周期領域において、指数収束率を達成した。さらに、Bourgainの枠組みを一般化して適用することで、解析的準周期領域を超えて解析的概周期設定まで理論を拡張し、より広範な異方性空間構造に対応させた。本結果は、解析性、空間構造、非共鳴条件、重み関数の選択、収束率の間の相互作用を明らかにする、周波数マップ解析における指数収束の初の統一理論を提供するものである。この枠組みは天体力学などの応用分野において重要な意義を持ち、重み付きBirkhoff平均の研究に新たな知見をもたらす。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02182v1.appendix: 本研究は力学系の解析手法に関するものであり、特に解析的写像や非共鳴条件を扱う点において、complex dynamicsやarithmetic dynamicsの分野に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02114v1.title: Pn上の自己準同型に対する対数的Calabi--Yau構造
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02114v1.summary: q > 1 を満たすq-偏極自己準同型 f: Pⁿ → Pⁿ とその分岐因子 R_f について、対 (Pⁿ, R_f) の特異性を調査した。一般的な f に対して (Pⁿ, R_f) が対数的標準（log canonical）であることを示している。特に n = 2 の場合、ある正の整数 s が存在して、対数的標準閾値 lct(P², R_fˢ) ≥ 1/(qˢ - 1) となることを証明した。この反復操作は一般に必要であり、下限は最適である。これにより (P², R_fˢ/(qˢ - 1)) が対数的Calabi--Yau対となり、滑らかな射影曲面に対する厳行（Gongyo）予想を完結させた。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02114v1.appendix: 複素力学系（complex dynamics）および算術力学系（arithmetic dynamics）に関連する代数幾何学的な性質を扱っています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02111v1.title: Thompsonの群 V の部分群に関するグラフ理論的特徴付け
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02111v1.summary: 本論文では、Thompsonの群 V の有限生成部分群に関するグラフ理論的な特徴付けを証明している。具体的には、有限生成群が V に埋め込めるための必要十分条件は、それが忠実な文脈自由作用（faithful context-free action）を持つこと、あるいは文脈自由グラフの遷移群のクラス CF-TR に属することであることを示した。この結果を用い、共文脈自由（co-context-free）な語の問題を持つ既知の群がすべて V に埋め込めることを示し、Lehnertの予想を支持する証拠を提示した。また、V の有限生成部分群は、仮想アーベル群であるか、非アーベル自由半群を含むかのいずれかであることを証明し、中間成長群は V に埋め込めないことを導いた。さらに、文脈自由グラフの遷移群の性質や、Basilica群およびHanoi Towers群が V に埋め込めないことを、Schreierグラフの幾何学的性質を用いて証明した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02111v1.appendix: 本論文は、形式言語理論（context-free action, CF-TR）や、大きな可算無限群の構造（Thompson's group V の部分群構造）、さらには複素力学系に由来する群（Basilica group）の幾何学的性質に関連しており、指定された興味ある分野と深く関わっています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02025v1.title: ねじれのない非ソフィカル群
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02025v1.summary: OpenAIがバイナリLeavitt代数の単元群が非ソフィカル（non-sofic）群であることを発表したことを受け、本論文では同様の技術的基準に基づき、ねじれのない（torsion-free）群を含む新しい非ソフィカル群の構成法を提示する。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02025v1.appendix: この論文は「structure of large countable infinite group」の分野に関連しています。先行研究で示されたバイナリLeavitt代数の単元群とは異なる、ねじれのない例を提示している点が重要です。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02013v1.title: Triguarded Fragment (三階ガード付き断片)
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02013v1.summary: 本論文では、一階述語論理(FO)の決定可能な断片である「ガード付き断片(GF)」と「2変数断片(FO2)」を統合した新しい断片、Triguarded Fragment (TGF)を提案している。TGFは、3つ以上の自由変数を持つ部分論理式に対してのみ量化のガードを要求することで、GFの定義を緩和し、GFとFO2の両方を包含する。等号の使用を制限した場合、満たし得なさはN2ExpTime完全であり、述語の最大アリティを固定するとNExpTime完全となる。また、データ計算量はNP完全であり、有限モデル性も保持することが示されている。一方で、等号の自由な使用などの自然な拡張は決定不能性に繋がることも明らかにされた。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.02013v1.appendix: 本論文は、決定可能性の境界を特定する計算理論的な側面から、automata theory(オートマトン理論)に関連する可能性があります。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01984v1.title: 種数2におけるTeichmüller曲線の最小双曲面積
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01984v1.summary: 本論文では、種数2の閉リーマン面上の正則2次微分から生じるTeichmüller曲線の最小双曲面積が3π/5であることを示した。この最小値は、double-pentagon（重五角形）平坦面のGL₂⁺(ℝ)軌道に属する2次微分（q=ω²の形式）において正確に達成され、これは極値を与える射影Veech群が三角形群Δ(2, 5, ∞)であることに対応する。証明には、小面積の非コンパクト双曲オービフォールドの分類と、非平方2次微分に対する導関数を保持するアフィン降下（affine descent）構成法が組み合わされており、算術的・マーク付き点・被覆の障害を用いることで、可能性のある3つの非平方零点パターンを排除している。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01984v1.appendix: 本論文は、平坦面やVeech群の幾何・力学系を扱っており、複素力学系（complex dynamics）の分野に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01983v1.title: 単一関係式群および単一関係式モノイドにおけるディオファントス問題の決定不能性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01983v1.summary: 本論文では、単一関係式群および単一関係式モノイドにおける係数付き方程式を解く問題（ディオファントス問題）が、一般に決定不能であることを証明した。具体的には、d ≥ 2 における Baumslag-Gersten 群 B_d = BG(1, d) および、それに関連する単一関係式モノイド M_d のディオファントス問題が共に決定不能であることを示している。これらの結果は、Rybalov による最近の決定不能性の結果をエンコードする手法を用いることで得られた。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01983v1.appendix: 本論文は Baumslag-Gersten 群という無限群の性質を扱っており、興味ある分野の「structure of large countable infinite group」と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01982v1.title: Octopus: P4パケットパーサの実用的な等価性判定
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01982v1.summary: P4は、プロトコル非依存のパケット処理を記述するためのドメイン特化言語であり、パケットパーサは入力ビットストリームをヘッダとフィールドに構造化する役割を担う。本論文では、P4パケットパーサをオートマトンに変換し、それらの等価性を（シンボリックに）検証するツール「Octopus」を提案する。先行研究と比較して、Octopusは民生用ハードウェア上で非自明なパーサの等価性を数分以内に検証可能であり、等価性の証拠となる双模倣（bisimulation）または振る舞いの差異を示す反例ビットストリームを出力する。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01982v1.appendix: 本論文は、パケットパーサをオートマトンに変換して解析を行うという点で、興味ある分野の「automata theory」および「formal languages」と密接に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01781v1.title: 素数法における階乗剰余：平方根の境界を超えて
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01781v1.summary: 本論文では、素数 p に対して集合 Aₚ = {k! mod p : 1 ≤ k < p} の濃度を評価し、従来の一般的な下界である (√2 - o(1))p^(1/2) を改良する |Aₚ| ≫ p^(8/15) を証明している。証明の主眼は、有限体 Fₚ における恒等式 (n+2)! = (n+1)! + ((n+1)!)^2/n! を用いて、一次分数変換の族に対する多数の接続（incidence）を導出することにある。Cauchy–Schwarzの不等式の適用後、これらの変換間の遷移写像が重複度高々2の線形写像となることを示し、Stevensおよびde Zeeuwによるデカルト積上の点線接続定理（point-line incidence theorem）を適用することで指数 8/15 を得ている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01781v1.appendix: 本論文は、数論的組合せ論（arithmetic combinatorics）の手法を用いて有限体上の代数構造を解析しており、[興味ある分野]の中では combinatorics on words や arithmetic dynamics と数学的対象や手法において関連性を持ちます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01700v1.title: Lefschetz pencil に対する指標多様体へのモノドロミー作用
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01700v1.summary: リーマン面 Σ に対し、十分豊富な Lefschetz pencil から生じる複素曲線族のモノドロミー部分群 Γ ⊆ Mod(Σ) の作用を考察している。本論文では、群 Γ が π₁(Σ) の特定の指標多様体上でザリスキー稠密な軌道を持つ、あるいはエルゴード的に作用することを証明した。これは Katzarkov, Pantev, Simpson が 2003 年に提示した予想の一つの形を解決するものである。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01700v1.appendix: この論文は、興味ある分野のうち complex dynamics および structure of large countable infinite group (写像類群の部分群の性質) に関連しています。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01569v1.title: 混合マルコフ準周期コサイクルのリャプーノフ指数の解析性
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01569v1.summary: 本論文では、混合マルコフ準周期コサイクルの最大リャプーノフ指数が遷移確率にどのように依存するかを調査している。遷移行列が原始的であり、トーラス上のマルコフ拡張が有向サイクルに沿って非共鳴、かつ最大リャプーノフ指数が単純であるという条件下で解析が行われた。既約なケースについては、前方マルコフ転送作用素と初期マルコフ状態に対して一様な収束推計を用いることで解析性を示した。可約なケースについては、可測な不変切断に沿って制限コサイクルと商束コサイクルに分解し、ファイバーの次元に関する帰納法を用いることで結果を導いている。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01569v1.appendix: symbolic dynamics（記号力学系）に関連する内容を含んでいます。

http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01550v1.title: Quandle代数のべき等元、自己同型群、および交換子幅
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01550v1.summary: 本論文ではQuandle（カンドル）代数の理論を構築・発展させている。標数が2ではない整域上において、順序可換なQuandleから生成される代数には非自明なべき等元が存在しないことを証明した。また、任意の可換環上における、自明なQuandleおよび奇数位数の二面体Quandleの自己同型群を決定し、偶数位数の二面体Quandleについても部分的な結果を得た。さらに、計算機探索を用いることで、交換子幅が2となるQuandle代数の初となる具体例を提示した。
http://arxiv.org/abs/2608.01550v1.appendix: 提示された「興味ある分野」の中では群構造の解析や組み合わせ論的な側面に関連がありますが、直接的に合致する特定の分野（Symbolic dynamicsやAutomata theory等）は含まれていません。本研究は代数的トポロジーや結び目理論に起源を持つQuandleの代数的性質に焦点を当てたものです。

papers.title: Discrete homology computations by reduction to zero differentials
papers.summary: We develop a new algorithm for computing (persistent) discrete homology of graphs using reduction to zero differentials and active enumeration. This allows us to compute the fourth homology group of the Greene sphere, along with several previously unknown groups. We also show that persistent discrete homology computes faster than simplicial homology of Vietoris-Rips complex in the high-noise non-metric settings, making it a better choice for noisy data sets.

papers.title: Dimension Rigidity and Projective Geometry of Trace-Product Switchings of the Gold Cube
papers.summary: We completely classify a natural scalar trace-product switching of the Gold almost perfect nonlinear function $x\mapsto x^3$ in every even dimension. Nontrivial switchings occur only for $n=4,6,8$: the admissible coefficients are, respectively, the nonzero trace-zero elements, the six elements of multiplicative order nine, and $\mathbb{F}_4^{*}$. For every even $n\geq10$, no nonzero coefficient is admissible. The infinite range is excluded by additive-character estimates on a Fermat cubic, with exact finite bridges for $n=10,12$. The raw coefficient lists for $n=6,8$ appeared earlier in Arshad's dissertation; our contribution is their intrinsic description, a proof uniform in the dimension, and the resulting dimension-rigidity theorem. We also classify normalized rank-two extensions in dimension eight by $\mathbb{P}^{1}(\mathbb{F}_4)$. A binary trace selector accepts two coefficient values at each non-base projective point, and the eight accepted marked switchings form exactly two extended-affine, hence two CCZ, classes. A centre-independent low-rank derivative criterion reduces each rank-$r$ candidate to $2^r-1$ membership tests in precomputed forbidden sets. The global APN classes reached are known; the results describe their local organization around the Gold centre and rule out this switching mechanism in all larger even dimensions.

papers.title: A note on vector trifferent codes over the Sphere
papers.summary:
Let $S^2\subset \mathbb R^3$ be the unit sphere. A set $C\subset (S^2)^n$ is called vector trifferent if for every three distinct $x,y,z\in C$ there is a coordinate $i$ for which $x_i,y_i,z_i$ are mutually orthogonal. Bhandari and Khetan recently introduced this vectorial analogue of trifferent codes and proved the upper bound $|C|\le (\sqrt 2+o(1))(3/2)^n$. We improve the bound to: \[
  |C|\le (1+o(1))\left(\frac32\right)^n . \] The new ingredient in the proof is a local packing inequality obtained by two-coloring, around each codeword, the circles of vectors orthogonal to the corresponding coordinates. This replaces a global tensor-space bound by a centered estimate and gives exactly the missing factor in the leading constant.

papers.title: Physics-informed reduced-order modelling with equivariant spectral submanifolds
papers.summary: Spectral submanifold (SSM) reduction has emerged as a mathematically principled route to reliable nonlinear reduced-order models, capturing dynamics beyond the reach of linear techniques such as Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD). The computation of SSMs, however, remains computationally expensive, particularly for high-dimensional systems. In this work, we introduce equivariant spectral submanifold (eSSM) reduction, a novel extension of the SSM framework that explicitly incorporates symmetries of the full-order model into the reduction process. We establish the mathematical foundations of this approach by showing that SSMs are naturally equivariant submanifolds and that the associated charts and reduced dynamics inherit the appropriate induced group actions. Building on this framework, we develop a novel equivariant SSM reduction algorithm that exploits these symmetries to achieve substantially faster computations while also improving model robustness. We demonstrate the advantages of this approach on several benchmark problems including a test from the Common Task Framework for Science.

papers.title: Topological Semantics for Scoped Computational Paths
papers.summary:
Computational paths record equality as explicit finite traces of primitive steps. We give a topological semantics for a scoped rewrite presentation whose steps have continuous geometric realizations and whose named rewrites carry endpoint-fixed homotopies.
  For every presentation we construct a quotient arrow space with a canonical final-domain groupoid structure: multiplication is continuous on the quotient of explicitly composable representatives. We prove an exact four-way criterion for this final composable topology to agree with the ordinary pullback topology, together with a compact-Hausdorff sufficient condition. Thus the unconditional construction exposes, rather than hides, the product-quotient issue in ordinary topological groupoids.
  The realization map to geometric homotopy classes is a continuous groupoid morphism and is faithful exactly under a separate geometric-completeness condition. In the universal presentation, a continuous section identifies the coherent-path quotient homeomorphically with the usual quotient-topologized fundamental groupoid. We then give finite-generator circle and genuine torus examples, with winding-based normal forms and classifications by Z and Z^2. A Lean 4.24.0 development checks the theorem package; the mathematical presentation is independent of the implementation.
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz

papers.title: Bicriteria Approximation Algorithms for Demand Matching
papers.summary:
The demand matching problem generalizes both the knapsack problem and the $b$-matching problem. In this problem, each edge of a graph has a demand and a weight, each vertex has a capacity, and the goal is to find a maximum weight subset of edges whose total incident demand at every vertex does not exceed its capacity. We study $(α, β)$-bicriteria approximation algorithms, which return a solution of weight at least $1/α$ times the optimum while allowing an additive capacity violation of at most $β$ times the maximum edge demand.
  We give an iterative relaxation algorithm for the demand matching problem that exploits a structural characterization of strictly fractional extreme points of the natural LP relaxation, which reduces the residual rounding problem to odd-cycle instances. Combined with a better-of-two rounding strategy, this yields $(7/6, 1)$- and $(1, 1)$-bicriteria approximation algorithms for general and bipartite graphs, respectively. We further generalize this approach to obtain a parametric family of algorithms, including a $(1, 4/3)$-bicriteria approximation. Separately, for the more general $k$-hypergraph demand matching problem, we give a greedy, combinatorial $(k, 1)$-bicriteria approximation algorithm.
  We complement these algorithmic results with matching lower bounds relative to the natural LP relaxation for $β= 0$ and all $β\geq 1$, completely characterizing the trade-off between weight approximation and additive capacity violation in this range.

papers.title: Adversarially Robust Abductive Fusion of Pre-trained Transformer-based Perception Models
papers.summary: Deploying pre-trained perception models in novel environments degrades their accuracy under distributional shift, and assembling them alone does not recover it: combiners such as majority voting trade recall for precision and are brittle to coordinated failures. Prior metacognitive methods learn logical rules that flag a model's errors, but rely on hand-authored domain-knowledge cues (object-size priors, segmentation masks) that do not transfer to genuinely novel scenes. We show that this metacognitive layer can be learned without any domain knowledge by exploiting vector-space geometry: per-model Label Vector Pools (LVP), built from each model's own training embeddings, yield error-detection rules from the geometry of detections relative to training-determined prototypes, reaching parity with domain-knowledge rules to within $0.002$ every F1 on test set. Because the approach remains neurosymbolic, these geometric rules share a single logical framework and can still be complemented by domain knowledge when available. We frame the fusion of multiple imperfect ViT-based detectors as a consistency-based abduction problem solved at test time by an exact Integer Program (IP) and a polynomial-time heuristic. On an aerial-imagery benchmark of 15 weather-shifted test sets and six ViT detectors, our domain-knowledge-free layer matches the strongest majority-vote variant on clean data (within $0.005$ F1) and, unlike every majority-vote baseline, retains its performance under a coordinated label-flipping attack: at a $90\%$ flip rate it averages $0.42$ F1 versus $0.35$ for MV-Plurality (a $22\%$ relative gain) and attains the highest F1 on \emph{every} test set once the flip rate exceeds $0.4$

papers.title: A Dynamical Systems view of Feedback Synthesis
papers.summary: Control theory and dynamical systems are closely intertwined fields. Pontryagin's maximum principal offers a strong connection by providing a constructive way to synthesize feedback control laws via lifting the control system to a (Hamiltonian) dynamical system. Feedback laws can then be encoded as invariant manifolds of this induced dynamical system - under the condition that these manifolds project diffeomorphically back to the base control system. While feedback stabilization is impossible for many control systems, the above procedure can still be carried out. In this setting, the invariant manifold no longer projects diffeomorphically which results in the emergence of caustics. This paper offers an overview of the above connection by translating target sets from controls to isotropic submanifolds in symplectic geometry and associates feedback controllability to singularities of the induced invariant manifolds. Multiple low-dimensional examples are included to elucidate the theory.

papers.title: Elements represented as intersections of sets
papers.summary: For a natural number $n$ let $[n] = \{1,\ldots,n\}$. We say that a family ${\cal{S}}\subseteq 2^{[n]}$ is \emph{representing} if every singleton set of $[n]$ is an intersection of some sets from ${\cal{S}}$. We show that the smallest possible cardinality of a representing set for $[n]$ is the discrete inverse $s(n)$ of the Sperner's function $n\mapsto \binom{n}{\lfloor n/2\rfloor}$, which by Sperner's Theorem is the maximum number of elements in an antichain in $2^{[n]}$ when viewed as subset (or boolean) lattice. Specifically, $s(n)$ is then the smallest positive integer such that $2^{[n]}$ contains an $n$-element antichain. Some generalization, further applications and asymptotics in terms of the second real branch of the Lambert $W$ function are presented.

papers.title: Subhomogeneity and Arveson Boundary of Free Polyhedra
papers.summary: We study subhomogeneity of the minimal operator system over a polyhedral cone, or equivalently the size of irreducible Arveson boundary points of free polyhedra. We obtain a complete classification in dimension three for cones (equivalently, dimension two for polytopes): cones with three extreme rays are 1-subhomogeneous, cones with four extreme rays are 2-subhomogeneous, and cones with at least five extreme rays are not subhomogeneous. In the last case, we construct irreducible Arveson boundary points at every even matrix level. We prove that subhomogeneity passes to faces and face quotients. We also determine the size of irreducible Arveson boundary points of free polyhedra over products of two simplices, obtaining a dichotomy between the product of two segments and all remaining cases. As applications, we classify n-dimensional cones with n+1 extreme rays. More generally, when every facet omits at most two extreme rays, we show that subhomogeneity occurs exactly for direct sums of simplicial cones and three-dimensional four-ray cones. We also construct, for a range of fixed dimensions and ray counts, cones exhibiting both subhomogeneous and non-subhomogeneous behavior.

papers.title: All parallel chip-firing games with $2|E|-|V|<|σ|<2|E|$ have period $2$
papers.summary: In 2010, Levine found that the activity functions of parallel chip-firing games on the complete graph $K_n$ converge to a devil's staircase pattern: adding chips causes activity to progress through open intervals in which it is locally constant. In 2022, Bu, Choi, and Xu improved on an earlier bound by Kominers and Kominers to show that there exists a strict lower bound below which all games have activity $0$, and a strict upper bound above which all games have activity $1$. They thereby generalized the bottom and topmost rungs of the devil's staircase to all graphs. In 2024, Ji, Li, and Wang conjectured that a similarly general bound exists for games with activity $\tfrac12$. We use GPT-5.6-Sol to prove this conjecture, unifying existing results for trees, cycles, complete graphs, and complete bipartite graphs. This generalizes the middle rung of the devil's staircase.

papers.title: Kemeny's constant and Braess cliques in graphs
papers.summary: Kemeny's constant is used as a measure of the average travel time on a graph. Braess' paradox for graphs is the observation that in some graphs, when an edge is added, Kemeny's constant increases. We introduce the notion of a Braess clique $K_\ell$, a clique that when inserted into a graph on an independent set of $\ell$ vertices, will create an increase in Kemeny's constant. In this context, a Braess edge is a Braess $K_2$. We provide examples of graphs that have a Braess $K_\ell$ for $\ell\geq 3$. We observe that almost every connected planar labelled graph has a Braess $K_\ell$ for each $\ell\geq 3$. We also explore the relationship between Braess edges and Braess cliques in graphs.

papers.title: Period Homeostasis Near Hopf Bifurcation
papers.summary: Homeostasis is a biological phenomenon in which a function of the state of the system remains approximately constant as an input parameter varies. Recent mathematical work has developed a framework for studying homeostasis using methods from singularity theory. In this framework, the requirement that the function of the state remain approximately constant is replaced by the condition that the derivative of the function with respect to the input parameter vanishes at an isolated point. This zero-derivative condition is called infinitesimal homeostasis. Much of the existing theory concerns steady states. In this paper, we develop an analogous theory for oscillatory systems in which the homeostatic quantity is the period of a stable periodic solution. We refer to this behavior as period homeostasis and to the corresponding zero-derivative condition as infinitesimal period homeostasis. Experimental studies in cyanobacteria and cultured human cells suggest that circadian rhythms can disappear through Hopf bifurcation as temperature decreases to a critical value, with the oscillation amplitude tending to zero. Motivated by this evidence, we focus on stable periodic solutions arising from nondegenerate Hopf bifurcation. We show that bifurcation theory and singularity theory can be used to find period homeostasis in parameterized ODE models. Our results connect the onset of oscillations with homeostasis of the period and yield a geometric description of parameter space that locally organizes the qualitative behavior of solutions of the ODE.

papers.title: On Strong Majority Edge Colourings with Few Colours
papers.summary:
A strong majority edge colouring of a graph $G$ is an edge colouring in which, for every edge $e$ and every colour $α$, at most half the edges adjacent to $e$ receive colour $α$. Like many related colouring notions, it admits a natural interpretation as a colouring problem for an associated hypergraph. Somewhat surprisingly, although the corresponding hypergraph may have arbitrarily large vertex degrees, a universal finite upper bound on the sufficient number of colours in a strong majority edge colouring exists under a natural modest minimum degree assumption, unlike in several other closely related majority concepts.
  We in particular prove that every graph $G$ with minimum degree $δ\ge5$ admits a strong majority edge colouring with three colours, improving both the previously known bound $δ\ge9$ for three colours and the result showing that four colours suffice whenever $δ\ge5$. Our result is best possible with respect to the number of colours and nearly best possible with respect to the minimum degree assumption, as we exhibit the latter cannot be decreased below $4$.
  We also introduce a more general framework of strong $1/k$-majority edge colourings and establish corresponding bounds for this setting.

papers.title: Experimental Kuramoto Platform
papers.summary: Phase reduction provides a principled relationship between high-dimensional oscillator dynamics and low-dimensional phase models such as the Kuramoto model. However, connecting analytical results derived from the Kuramoto framework to experimental data remains an open challenge, as many physical platforms violate the weak-coupling assumptions underlying standard phase reduction. Here, we present an experimental platform based on electronic quadrature oscillators whose phase dynamics are, under certain assumptions, equivalent to the Kuramoto model. Crucially, this equivalence is achieved for both weak and strong coupling through a non-diffusive coupling circuit, and the design approach supports arbitrary (weighted and directed) network topologies while preserving scalability and oscillation regularity. Across different coupling schemes, we demonstrate that the platform reliably reproduces phase transitions predicted by the Kuramoto model for both global and cluster synchronization. This cost-effective platform enables systematic experimental validation of analytical and numerical results for synchronization in complex networks.

papers.title: GEB-Bench: Abstract Structures Told in Many Voices
papers.summary: Can a model look at a river delta and a lightning bolt and see that they share a structure? We introduce GEB-Bench, a benchmark whose unit is an abstract structural motif--self-reference, a strange loop, a Mobius twist--in the spirit of Godel, Escher, Bach. Each motif is told in several voices: a natural scene whose composition is the structure, a folk story whose telling enacts it through a mechanically checkable form device, a mathematical theorem, and a programmatic skeleton; surface parameters are declared nuisance variables and never scored. Motifs, voices, and the structural changes between them form a small cross-modal category, and GEB-Bench's tasks are its questions. Evaluating twelve open and proprietary models, we find that abstraction failure is lawful. The central finding is a gap between recognition and cross-voice mapping: models identify a structure within one voice far better than they carry it across voices; every model pays this tax, and mapping strong enough to narrow it appears only at the frontier tier. Two patterns support it. Errors align more strongly with the designed formal geometry than with measured perceptual geometries, and frontier models from different vendors converge on the same wrong answers; and surface complexity taxes every model that reads structure, with capacity buying headroom rather than immunity. GEB-Bench is fully generative and released with its pipeline.

papers.title: Asymptotically attaining the Moore bound
papers.summary: For positive integers $d$ and $k$, let $n_k(d)$ be the maximum order of a graph of maximum degree at most $d$ and diameter at most $k$. We prove that $$ \lim_{d\to\infty}\frac{n_k(d)}{d^k}=1$$ for every fixed $k$, thereby resolving the asymptotic degree-diameter problem for fixed diameter and proving a conjecture of Bollobás. The lower bound comes from regular graphs $H_{k,q}$, indexed by prime powers $q$, whose vertices are partial flags in $\mathbb{F}_q^{\,2k+1}$. These graphs have diameter $k$ and order $|V(H_{k,q})| =(1+o(1))Δ(H_{k,q})^k$. We also construct, for every fixed $\ell \ge 2$, graphs of maximum degree at most $d$ and line-graph diameter at most $\ell$ with $(1+o(1))d^{\ell}$ edges.

papers.title: The structure of finite groups invariably generated by two elements of prime order
papers.summary: A group $G$ is invariably generated by two elements $a$ and $b$ if $G=\langle a^g,b^h\rangle $ for all $g,h\in G$. This paper provides a structural description of finite groups invariably generated by two elements of distinct prime orders $s$ and $t$. We illustrate the use of our main result in a case study with $s=2$ and $t=3$. In particular we prove that an almost simple group is invariably generated by an element of order $2$ and an element of order $3$ if and only if it is isomorphic to $\mathrm{PGL}_2(3^{2^b})$ for some $b \ge 1$.

papers.title: Resume Means Resume: A Machine-Checked Conformance Contract for Checkpoint, Interrupt, and Resume Semantics in Workflow Persistence Layers
papers.summary: A framework that persists execution state so a run can be interrupted, survive a crash, and continue must decide what a resume means for effects that already fired. Five widely deployed agent workflow frameworks answer differently, none exposes a machine-checkable contract, and behavior violates even the fragments they state. The RESUME CONTRACT states six properties over the persistence API (prefix continuation, effect exactly-once, fork determinism, checkpoint validity, consume-once, recovery determinism), plus fork-intent and liveness obligations. A TLA+ model checks a reference semantics exhaustively, unchanged at scaled bounds (7.4 million states); a 39-cell fault matrix and two companion modules yield the separating models independence requires, and consume-once splits, its consumption clause independent of all six others. A deterministic, LLM-free harness measures them at pinned releases. LangGraph 1.2.9 durably records a second resume value and never consults it, persists schema-invalid state silently, and re-executes durably recorded work after a real SIGKILL: exactly-once across interrupts, at-least-once across crashes, on one API. CrewAI 1.15.2 re-executes completed effect-bearing methods against its written claim; pydantic-graph 1.x cannot resume after a mid-node crash; no two probed frameworks share a conformance profile. Consume-once holds sequentially and fails under concurrent delivery: k processes resuming one parked interrupt fire the gated effect k times, saturation 1.0 in 36 of 40 cells, and the failure crosses hosts. REMIT, a reference sequencer whose Verus-verified recovery core is line-identical to the shipped executable, repairs the fork and validity cells. The cross-process cell is repaired at the read path, and that repair ships: an opt-in gate claims consumption in the shared store, serving one racer and refusing the rest before any node executes.

papers.title: $P$-polynomial coherent configurations
papers.summary: Suda introduced the notion of a $Q$-polynomial coherent configuration, which provides a natural and important concept. Subsequently, Lato introduced a notion of a $P$-polynomial coherent configuration and proved that every such configuration satisfying the definition has at most two fibers. Although Lato's definition is interesting, particularly because it characterizes distance-biregular graphs, we argue that an alternative definition is desirable. In this paper, we propose an alternative notion of $P$-polynomial coherent configurations that is naturally aligned with Suda's $Q$-polynomial framework. We show that every two-fiber coherent configuration that is $P$-polynomial in Lato's sense is also $P$-polynomial in our sense, whereas the converse does not hold. We further prove that every coherent configuration of type $(2,2;3)$, $(3,2;3)$ or $(3,3;3)$ is $P$-polynomial in our sense. In addition, we present three families of $P$-polynomial coherent configurations with an arbitrary number of fibers: those arising from tight Euclidean $t$-designs in $\mathbb R^2$, the Terwilliger algebra of $H(n,2)$, and the set of all subspaces of $\mathbb F_q^n$. Finally, we give an equivalent condition for the cross-block intersection matrices to be tridiagonal and verify that all three families satisfy this condition.

papers.title: From b-Coloring to $b^*$-Coloring: Large Girth and Parameterized Complexity
papers.summary:
A b-coloring is a proper vertex coloring such that every color class contains a vertex, a so-called b-vertex, which sees all colors in its closed neighborhood. This type of coloring has been intensively studied from both structural and algorithmic point of view. Recently, Zaker [DAM 2025] introduced the notion of a b*-coloring, which is a b-coloring in which there is a vertex that sees a b-vertex of every color in its closed neighborhood. The b*-chromatic number is the maximum integer k such that there is a b*-coloring with k colors.
  We partially answer a question posed by Zaker and prove that graphs of girth at least 7 are b*-monotonic, which means that the b*-chromatic number does not increase by taking an induced subgraph. In addition, we discover a class of d-regular graphs of girth at least 5 with b*-chromatic number d+1, which strengthens a result about b-colorings by Dettlaff, Furmańczyk, Peterin, Roux, and Ziemann [AMC 2024].
  We also study the parameterized complexity of finding b*-colorings, and show that for many structural parameters, the complexity coincides with that of finding b-colorings. In particular, the b*-chromatic number can be computed in polynomial time on any class of bounded clique-width. For most parameters, the translation from b-colorings is straightforward but for the feedback edge number, the FPT algorithm for b*-colorings is actually much simpler than that for b-colorings by Balabán [MFCS 2026].

papers.title: The Dehn function of Thompson's group $V$ is at most sextic
papers.summary: A remarkable result of Guba shows that the Dehn function of Thompson's group $F$ is quadratic (Inv. Math. 163:313-342). In another paper (Alg. prob. in Grps. and Semigrps, 91-120), Guba showed that Thompson's group $T$ and $V$ have Dehn functions bounded above by $n^7$ and $n^{11}$, respectively. Recently, Migliorini showed that the Dehn function of Thompson's group $T$ is also quadratic (For. of Math. Sigma, 13:e109). In this paper, we improve the upper bound of the Dehn function of Thompson's group $V$ to $n^6$ and explore the intricacies of its relations via explicit van Kampen diagrams.

papers.title: The Chow Polynomial of the Noncrossing Partition Lattice
papers.summary: We prove that the Chow polynomial of the noncrossing partition lattice is equal to the descent generating function of tieless parking functions. As a consequence, we obtain new results on the descent statistic for parking functions.

papers.title: Molecules of an affine FPF $W$-graph and an asymptotic row-Beissinger correspondence
papers.summary: Kazhdan--Lusztig $W$-graphs encode the cell structure of Hecke algebras, while their bidirected connected components are called molecules. In finite type~$A$, the Robinson--Schensted correspondence describes cells and molecules, and Beissinger's row insertion constructs the common tableau associated with an involution. In affine type~$A$, the affine matrix-ball construction assigns an affine permutation a pair of tabloids together with a dominant weight, and Marberg introduced affine FPF $W$-graphs indexed by affine fixed-point-free involutions. We prove that, for an affine fixed-point-free involution, complete two-cycle truncations followed by finite row Beissinger insertion asymptotically recover both its common AMBC tabloid and its dominant weight. We also identify the bidirected edges of $Γ_n^{\m}$ with dual equivalence moves under AMBC, obtaining a classification of its molecule.

papers.title: Computing Actual Causes for Neural Network Predictions under Structured Causal Inputs
papers.summary: Explaining the predictions of neural networks is a central challenge in trustworthy AI. Existing explanation methods, such as those based on feature attribution or minimal sufficient sets, typically treat input features as independent, which can yield misleading explanations when inputs exhibit structured dependencies. We address this by formalizing explanations as Halpern-Pearl (HP) actual causes, modeling input dependencies using Boolean Structural Causal Models (SCMs). We compute HP causes by applying bound propagation and branch-and-bound techniques, while providing formal guarantees of completeness and minimality. Our experiments show that we substantially outperform brute-force and ILP baselines in scalability, and outperform heuristic search as graph size grows, computing all minimal actual causes on instances with search spaces of up to $2.3\times10^{13}$ candidate (cause, contingency) pairs, on SCMs with up to 28 nodes, within a 180s per-instance budget. In a case study, we further show that ignoring input dependencies inflates the number of reported causes, 14.9% of which are spurious under our SCM.

papers.title: Sharp Orlicz Endpoints for Spatial-Temporal Ergodic Averaging
papers.summary:
We study the composition of temporal ergodic averaging with spatial averaging over shrinking metric balls, and determine sharp Orlicz endpoints for the corresponding unrestricted joint limit. For consecutive Birkhoff averages normalized by $NΛ_q(N)$ ($q\ge 0$), the sharp Orlicz endpoint is $L\log_{q+1}L$. In particular, the ordinary case $q=0$ yields an $L\log L$ local joint convergence theorem under the Lebesgue differentiation property alone, while $L^1$ fails even on the Euclidean interval, answering two questions of Young. The same $L\log_{q+1}L$ endpoint holds for prime averages for every $q\ge 1$. For arbitrary time sequences, $L\log_qL$ always suffices at the same normalization $NΛ_q(N)$ ($q\ge 1$), and this endpoint is sharp in the Orlicz sense for fixed-base exponential sequences $k^n$ ($k\ge 2$) and for sequences with polynomial ratio separation, including $n!$.
  The positive results rest on a local stability principle: under the ball Lebesgue differentiation property, pointwise temporal convergence lifts to the local joint limit whenever the associated temporal maximal function admits an $L^1$ majorant. The additional logarithm in the regular-time case comes from lifting restricted logarithmic maximal estimates from sets to general functions. The arbitrary-sequence theorem uses a dyadic decomposition instead. The lower bounds are local $\infty$-sweeping out constructions, obtained by weighted local sweeping out for polynomial-growth regular times, by residue constructions for polynomially ratio-separated sequences, and by digit constructions for fixed-base exponentials.

papers.title: Ranked spreadness and sample-based testing
papers.summary:
In this note, we introduce the notion of ranked spreadness, a strengthening of the usual spread condition in which the elements of each member can be ordered so that their one-coordinate marginals decay geometrically with their rank. This additional structure removes the dependence on the maximum set size in random-containment estimates. We prove width-free hitting and weighted-concentration theorems for ranked-spread set systems, together with an elementary kernel-extraction theorem showing that ranked spreadness arises naturally in arbitrary distributions on small sets.
  Our main application is to the simulation of nonadaptive property testers by sample-based testers. If a one-sided tester has average query complexity $d$ and rejects every far input with probability at least $δ$, then, for every integer $c>d/δ$, it admits a one-sided sample-based simulation with expected sample complexity $O_{d,δ,|Σ|}\bigl(n^{1-1/c}\bigr)$. More generally, if positive inputs are rejected with probability at most $γ$ and far inputs with probability at least $δ>γ$, the same conclusion holds for every $c>d/(δ-γ)$. In particular, for constant-query nonadaptive testers we obtain an exponent $1-Θ(1/q)$, matching, up to the dependence on the rejection gap, the exponent conjectured by Fischer, Lachish, and Vasudev.

papers.title: Statistical Verification of Quantitative Hyperproperties: Beyond Boolean Quantification
papers.summary: Formalisms for hyperproperties provide a solid foundation for studying the verification problem across classes of relational properties, such as those in information flow control (IFC). However, existing formalisms remain limited in expressiveness when it comes to capturing practical aspects of real-world systems. In particular, they do not adequately account for the quantitative nature of such systems. In this paper, we address this gap by revisiting the specification and verification of hyperproperties from a quantitative, measure-based, perspective. We introduce Quantitative Hyper-Logic (QHL), which replaces qualitative trace quantifiers with measure-based ones and extends temporal predicates with richer quantitative expressions. We further study the verification problem from a statistical verification point of view, and develop algorithms for the statistical verification of QHL specifications. For the introduced measure-based quantifiers, we particularly provide an analysis in terms of sample complexity and achievable statistical guarantees. In particular, we show how statistical methods such as Hoeffding's inequality and extreme value theory can be combined to develop statistical verification algorithms for nested measure-based quantifiers. Our approach provides quantitative alternatives for where traditional verification methods become infeasible. We demonstrate both expressiveness and efficacy on benchmarks from quantitative IFC, comparing against qualitative methods.

papers.title: On the dependence of the zero-free region of a partition function on the external field
papers.summary: Let $\{0, 1\}^n$ be the Boolean cube, endowed with the probability product measure, where ${\Bbb P}(1)=p$ and ${\Bbb P}(0)=q$ with $0 < p \leq q=1-p$.
